summary: A Sydney family law firm with named lawyers and awards appears to lose enquiries to empty sections, repeated messages and no way to book online.

findings.problem: The Year 2026, 2025 and 2024 labels and the Family Law Explainers block appear to show no content under them.
findings.cost: Empty blocks make the firm look unfinished.

findings.problem: The same award appears to be listed under different names, and Send Us A Message appears about seven times.
findings.cost: Inconsistent awards weaken credibility and repeated prompts add noise.
findings.fix: One clean awards row and one clear contact path.

findings.problem: A 4.9 rating from over 248 Google reviews appears to be linked out with no review quotes on the page.
findings.cost: Worried clients want to read what others said before they call.
findings.fix: Real review quotes on the page.

findings.problem: Book a consultation online appears to open the general contact page, and no opening hours appear.
findings.cost: Clients in a hard moment give up when the next step is unclear.
findings.fix: A real consultation booking with hours shown.

redesign: Clean awards and no empty sections.
A real booking flow with hours.
